label: realcommercial.com.au Scraper
title: realcommercial.com.au Scraper: Sale, Lease, Sold & Leased
metaDescription: Scrape realcommercial.com.au for sale, lease, sold and leased property by link, suburb, postcode or state: price, area, zoning and agents.
intro: Search realcommercial.com.au by link, suburb, postcode or state (for sale, for lease, sold or leased) and get price, address, floor and land area, zoning, photos, brochure PDFs and agent and agency phones.
useCases: Track commercial lease rates in a suburb
Monitor new offices, shops and warehouses for sale

faq.a: Only for agencies publishing listings. This actor searches by link, suburb, postcode or state (for sale, for lease, sold or leased) and returns every commercial listing.

faq.q: Can I use it as a realcommercial.com.au API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

officialApi: REA Group offers APIs to agencies for publishing listings, not for public data. This actor reads the public realcommercial.com.au search results.
